verdict.rationale: Keycloak is a standards-based OIDC/OAuth 2.0 server. It documents a well-known discovery endpoint, a set of standard auth endpoints, client registration via the admin console, and refresh-token handling through its introspection and revocation endpoints. An official Node.js adapter and community reports of a simple OAuth 2.0/OIDC interface back this up, though some users found it hard to use without prior OIDC knowledge. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the authorization code flow with PKCE, and hands-on evidence of client-side libraries removing protocol handling.
